records.generatedCopy: GitHub Copilot now separates OpenTelemetry identity attribution from prompts, responses, tool arguments, tool output, and policy details. That gives enterprise teams a better starting point for adoption evidence without routinely logging agent content, but it is not a privacy guarantee. This rollout checklist provides an explicit identity-only managed object, a policy-precedence receipt, six synthetic raw-span canaries, and separate attribution and data-minimization gates. GitHub documents the control surface; each team still needs to verify its own clients, harnesses, collector access, retention, and deletion.
